company.name: AegisAI
company.shortDescription: Aegis AI is an email security platform that leverages AI agents to analyze emails like human analysts.
company.description: Aegis AI develops an AI-native email security platform that helps organizations detect and respond to email-based cyber threats. The platform uses coordinated AI agents to analyze email content, sender behavior, and communication patterns to identify phishing attempts, business email compromise, malware, ransomware, spam, and other evolving threats. It integrates with email services such as Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 through APIs, allowing deployment without requiring changes to existing mail routing. The platform provides automated threat detection, quarantine and remediation capabilities, along with reporting and visibility into targeted attacks and security trends. Aegis AI also supports security teams by reducing manual review efforts and adapting to emerging email threats through AI-driven analysis rather than relying solely on static rules or signatures.
